summary: Frontend-only testing of Banking Agent (Agent 10) on preview URL. All 11 requested UI/integration flows verified: password gate, upload/previous statements list, dashboard summary cards, Overview (monthly bar + category pie + txn types), Categories tab (bar + table + row-click nav → filtered transactions with active-filter badge), Top Merchants tab (bar + 50 rows table + row-click nav → filtered transactions), Trends tab (daily balance area + monthly net bar), Transactions view (2877 total, 100/page, pagination Page 2 of 29, sort headers, category/txn_type/date/debit-only filters, search, clear filters), and Landing page Banking Agent card. Recharts rendered SVGs correctly on all 4 tabs. No blocking bugs; only a benign React hydration warning caused by preview-tool injected <span> inside <option>.

integration_issues.issue: handleFilterMerchant sets merchant filter and clears category, but subsequently selecting a category filter in the Transactions view does NOT clear the merchant filter (and vice versa via category-badge click in table). This causes counter-intuitive 0-row results when a user changes one filter while the other is still active (e.g. merchant=Mahesh Misra + category=Gaming returned 0 rows/‘0 transactions’). Consider making the category dropdown clear the merchant filter (or expose merchant chip more prominently) so users understand the intersection.

issues: Some pie slice labels overflow the container width at 1920px (labels 'Person Transfer 20%', 'ed 17%', 'Credit Card P', 'Cash Withdrawal 7%' are clipped by the chart card). Consider using shorter labels or a legend instead of on-slice labels.

design_issues.screen: Transactions view (with filter carried from dashboard)
issues: When arriving at Transactions view via a merchant/category row-click, the ‘Filters’ panel is collapsed by default so users may not realize why the count is low. Consider auto-expanding when an active filter chip exists.

action_items: (Low) Decide filter-interaction UX: selecting category in dropdown should probably clear an active merchant chip, and vice-versa, or show combined chips more clearly.
(Low) Fix pie label clipping on the Overview → Spending by Category chart at large widths.

(Cosmetic) Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears to originate from preview-tool DOM injection (x-file-name spans), not app code; if reproduced in production build, wrap option content in a fragment/string only.
critical_code_review_comments: BankingAgent.jsx is 645 lines — consider splitting into subcomponents (SummaryCards, OverviewTab, CategoriesTab, MerchantsTab, TrendsTab, TransactionsView) for maintainability.
Filter reset behavior is inconsistent — handleFilterMerchant clears category and vice versa, but the in-panel select does not; leads to unexpected 0-row states.
Transactions table uses index as fallback key (key={t._id || i}); mixing index keys with real IDs on same list can cause reconcile issues on filter/sort changes — prefer a stable txn id.
Pie chart pushes ‘Others’ into pieData via .push on the sliced array (mutates the sliced reference); works since slice returns new array but safer to build immutably.
Toggle chart X-axis interval uses Math.floor(balanceTrend.length / 15) which can be 0 causing every-label render on tiny datasets; guard with Math.max(1, ...).
